## Key Features:

- **Responsive Design**: The text scales appropriately on different screen sizes (2.5rem on mobile, 4rem on tablet, 5rem on desktop)
- **Persian Text Support**: The effect works perfectly with RTL Persian text
- **Smooth Animation**: 15-second continuous animation with diagonal stripes moving across the text
- **Performance Optimized**: Uses CSS animations instead of JavaScript for better performance
- **Accessibility**: Maintains the original text content while adding visual enhancement

The effect creates a beautiful animated diagonal stripe pattern that moves across your Persian heading text, giving it a dynamic and eye-catching appearance that will draw attention to your main call-to-action message.

The animation will start automatically when the page loads and continue running smoothly, creating an engaging visual effect that complements your existing Framer Motion animations.
